portInfo.description: Port of Brisbane publishes a Cruise hub covering the facility, getting here, the terminal, car parking, ship schedule, FAQs, contacts and accessibility. An important operational note states the BICT is only open when a cruise ship is at berth; prepaid parking is managed by Wilson Parking with limited drive-up in Car Park 3. Cruise guests seeking sailing details are directed to their line or travel agent. Quay engineering metrics were not on the captured overview HTML.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: South Bank / CBD — ~180 min with transfer.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Don’t arrive on a non-ship day expecting the terminal to be open.
